items.title: Russia's Defence Ministry claims overnight strikes hit 7 Ukrainian energy facilities and a Kyiv data centre
items.summary: In a Wednesday statement, Russia's Defence Ministry said its forces struck 7 Ukrainian energy facilities plus a Kyiv data centre in a 'massive' overnight attack that it said targeted facilities benefiting Ukraine's military, carried out with ground-launched missiles and long-range strike drones. Named targets: two heat-and-power plants in Kyiv, one more in the wider Kyiv region, a thermal power plant and an electricity substation, a Kharkiv heat-and-power plant, and a thermal plant in southeast Kharkiv region said to supply Ukraine's military; the Kyiv data centre was described as used to gather intelligence on Russian forces. The open admission contrasts with Tuesday's MOD claim that no energy targets were hit and with Peskov's continued 'contacts are ongoing' line, and it undercuts Trump's announced 'energy ceasefire'.
